report.answer: NOT DECIDABLE for automatic demotion. The locked detector achieved 58% accuracy (95% Wilson interval 44.2%-70.6%), with 44% machine recall and 72% human specificity; it would auto-demote 7 of 25 genuine human documents. The same-set fixed coin draw scored 44%. This bounded Q&A result is not reliable enough to gate sources and does not cover live SEO pages.
